exposure: Tranexamic acid (TXA) administered intravenously at 5, 10, or 15 mg/kg
Simulated doses of TXA at 500 mg and 650 mg
cohort: 30 pregnant women scheduled for caesarean delivery who received varying intravenous doses of tranexamic acid.
finding: A 650 mg dose of tranexamic acid is suggested to provide adequate postpartum haemorrhage prophylaxis for up to 1 hour in pregnant women undergoing caesarean delivery, which is less than the currently used 1000 mg dose.
